The block applies a parameterized single-qubit rotation (RY) followed by a controlled-phase interaction (implemented via CNOT-RZ-CNOT) to the next qubit in the cycle. All single-qubit rotations share parameter 'p0' and all two-qubit interactions share 'p1'. This structure respects the cyclic symmetry of the graph nodes, hypothesizing that the connectivity property is invariant under cyclic relabeling, which aligns with the graph's potential rotational symmetry in the feature space. The block is repeated twice per layer to allow for deeper propagation of connectivity information.
